method: fixed git-show blobs, AST parse and manual data-flow reading; no model import/execution

new_module_direct_identifier_scan.limit: Identifier screening alone is not proof of absence of indirect leakage.

findings.fact: record_matching receives model state, visible scene, selected definition/alignment; excludes U and unmapped/nonvisible relations. q uses the same C* distribution selector as matching; weight uses the current individual attention and visible k2 structure.

D matching runs inside real selection before the prediction returns; C* phase encloses that prediction. Individual attention is set from agent input before prediction and updated from the answer only after disclosure in the ledger-record hook.

Answer usage reads the emitted prediction and R_used trace, not a correctness score; use_amount writes the decayed S vector by the maximum amount in the same trial. Birth calls the previous birth implementation and records one usage.

The old _kinds researcher classification is attached to forget/snapshot records. The candidate filter reads strength, birth time and tau; the displayed kind is not read by that filter. The new wrapper calls the existing conversion function and serializes its audit afterward; it does not load a researcher record.

Visible relation IDs index the chosen alignment; memory identity contains definition name/slot/birth time. k2 keys use structural paths. No dynamic name/ID permutation or prediction comparison was performed, so this is not a rename gate pass.
